territory: Spec sheet, with the Merge Y as the symbol

ground.role: Page background. Warm paper, never pure white.

surface.role: Raised bands, cards, code blocks, table headers. 5.9 L* below ground, so a band reads as a plane.

raised.role: A box on a surface band. In light this is the ground: lighter than the band, so it reads as lifted.

ink.role: Headlines and body text. 16.2:1 on ground.

muted.role: Secondary text, captions, margin notes, section numbers. Warm, like the paper. 6.1:1 on ground, 5.2:1 on surface.

mid.role: The mid-tone. Strong hairlines, hover borders, grid major lines, inactive marks. Never text.

rule.role: Hairlines and grid lines only. Never text. Holds on ground and on surface.

signal.role: Graphics only: the Merge Y branch, headline markers, key-figure rules, status squares. 4.0:1, fails as body text.

signal_type.role: Signal as text. Rare: one key figure per page at most, never beside a signal graphic. 5.9:1 on ground.

surface.role: Raised bands, cards, code blocks, table headers. 9.8 L* above ground: dark needs a larger step than light. Near-neutral, so it sits with the cool ground.

raised.role: A box on a surface band. Lighter than the band, so it reads as lifted, not cut out.

ink.role: Headlines and body text. 15.5:1 on ground.

muted.role: Secondary text, captions, margin notes, section numbers. 7.0:1 on ground, 4.7:1 on raised.

mid.role: The mid-tone. Strong hairlines, hover borders, grid major lines, inactive marks. Never text.

rule.role: Hairlines and grid lines only. Never text. Holds on ground, surface and raised.

signal.role: Graphics: the Merge Y branch, markers, key-figure rules, status squares. 5.0:1 on ground.

signal_type.role: Signal as text. Rare, as in light. 6.6:1 on ground.

mono.role: Figures, code, section numbers, metadata, margin notes.

glyph.name: Merge Y
glyph.meaning: The Y is a merge diagram. The right arm and stem are the main line; the left arm is the branch, in signal, meeting it across a hairline seam.
